# Where the test files come from

Most files here are made by `tests/make_fixtures.py`. The ones below aren't.

- `xfa-imm1344e.pdf`: IMM 1344, "Application to Sponsor, Sponsorship
  Agreement and Undertaking", a filled-in sample of an XFA form by
  Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada. It's a real government form
  that is free to use but not to be sold, as printed at the bottom of each
  page. The copy here is `test/pdfs/xfa_filled_imm1344e.pdf` from the pdf.js
  project (https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js), where it's used for the same
  kind of test. The names and answers in it are made up.
